prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: the final illustration of a dark Jackie Leven tribute timeline, a quiet still life of his memorial bench.

INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the ORIGINAL photograph and the reference for the distinctive wooden bench, guitar-like backrest with round sound-hole and horizontal string-like slits, flowers hanging from a ribbon, glass candle vessel, loose flowers on the seat and rectangular inscribed plaque. Image 2 is a DRAWING STYLE reference only: use its rough dry-brush ink, broad reduced neutral-grey shapes, subdued values and edges disappearing into almost black. Do NOT include its person, face or clothing.

Compose a new vertical 4:5 still life centred on the empty bench. Show the distinctive shaped backrest, round opening, stylized parallel horizontal slits, a good portion of the seat and the near side support. Allow dark breathing room around it. The trailing bouquet of pale flowers and leaves hangs at the round opening. A glass hurricane candle vessel rests on the seat with a few loose fallen blossoms nearby. The rectangular metal plaque leans at the right of the seat, naturally integrated into the bench scene, not presented as a tombstone or as floating typography. Reframe and slightly adjust the objects into a balanced upright composition instead of duplicating the square snapshot. Preserve the bench's specific guitar motif. Background is abstract almost black; remove the house window, door, building details and coloured ribbon effects.

PLAQUE TEXT must be accurate, legible and contain exactly this quoted sentence:
"Eternal is the warrior
who finds beauty
in his wounds"
Render the quotation in simple dark serif lettering on the muted grey plaque, with natural perspective and modest size. Preserve spelling and word order exactly. Keep quotation marks. No added date, dedication, heading, signature, logo or any other text.

Draw with broad, imperfect dry-brush ink strokes, a small number of calm grey planes and selectively broken lines. Clearly drawn and moderately abstract, matching image 2 rather than photorealistic. The weathered wood is suggested by a few strong horizontal gestures and gaps, not dense photographic grain or every flake. Flowers are recognizable but reduced to a handful of soft angular brush shapes; foliage largely dissolves into charcoal. Glass is suggested by sparse rim and side contours and a muted candle shape, no elaborate reflections, flame glow or warm light. The plaque remains readable without becoming bright or dominating. Keep major object geometry convincing, especially the seat, backrest and round opening.

Strictly neutral black, charcoal and subdued greys on anthracite #0d0f12. No sepia, brown wood, yellow, green foliage, blue ribbon, beige or coloured tint. Darken the originally light wood into subdued charcoal and middle-dark grey, so the scene belongs to the same low-key series. Pale flowers and glass accents in muted mid-grey, not white glare. Natural positive lighting rather than inverted outlines. Large areas remain deep dark negative space. Frayed brush edges of the bench and lower seat merge into the background, with no hard rectangular photograph boundary.
No people, portrait, ghost, angel, cross, additional symbolic props, artificial light rays or decorative border. No photographic texture filter, smooth airbrushing, vector polygons, repeated pebbly texture or glossy impasto. One standalone vertical 4:5 illustration.
